data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Prescriptions issued in the Isle of Man and dispensed in England are subject to specific reimbursement arrangements that require robust monitoring. The Isle of Man Reports in ePACT2 provide authorised users with detailed data on prescribing activity and associated costs for these prescriptions, ensuring transparency and compliance with financial agreements.

The reports capture information such as item volumes, Net Ingredient Cost (NIC), and dispensing contractor details. Users can filter by time period and therapeutic category, enabling targeted analysis and trend identification. These reports support commissioners and finance teams in validating claims, reconciling invoices, and monitoring prescribing patterns across borders.

The aim of the Isle of Man Reports is to provide visibility and accountability for prescriptions originating outside England. They help organisations assess whether prescribing aligns with clinical guidance and contractual arrangements, reducing unwarranted variation and improving patient safety. While the reports offer detailed financial and operational insights, they should be used alongside other dashboards to provide context and inform medicines optimisation strategies. Their intention is to support compliance with NHS payment rules, strengthen governance, and ensure efficient use of resources across the health system.
